summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of the first installment (R$ 752 million) of an economic subvention program for diesel oil commercialization under Brazilian Provisional Measure No. 1,340. This is a routine operational and regulatory update from a foreign private issuer, not a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic changes are mentioned. The filing is merely a disclosure of a government subsidy payment, with no implications for corporate control or capital structure. As such, it does not qualify as a special-situation event.
